title: 2023 Panini Select Premier Level Black & Red Prizm Die-Cut #140 Patrick Mahomes
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2023 Panini Select Premier Level Black & Red Prizm Die-Cut #140 Patrick Mahomes trading card is a must-have for any fan of the Kansas City Chiefs or the National Football League (NFL). Featuring a stunning design and high-quality materials, this sports trading card is perfect for collectors and enthusiasts alike.

With its Silver Prizm Die-Cut parallel/variety and Base Set features, this card is a true gem. Manufactured by Panini, a trusted name in the industry, this card is sure to be a valuable addition to any collection. Don't miss your chance to own this beautiful trading card.
